lockedMove.speaker: Victor Stenger
lockedMove.excerpt: provid now in any debate the side that has the far tougher job is the side that has the higher burden of proof Dr Craig knows this and is very good at trying to cast the burden on his opponents but by any measure Dr Craig is the one who has the greater burden because he's the one making the more extravagant claim I CL he can understand everything naturally in terms of matter alone Dr Craig who proposes that a super being exists of unimagined power and goodness and I insist that this is unnecessary uh to understand the world I
lockedMove.proposition: The more extraordinary supernatural claim bears the heavier burden; plausible natural origin and complexity scenarios suffice for Stenger’s alternative.
